blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — More than a year after President Ferdinand Marcos Jr. met with President Donald Trump, the US leader will visit the Philippines for the first stop of his three-day trip to Asia. The visit will mark Trump’s first trip to the country since 2017, when he attended the 31st Asean Summit and was met with large protests in Manila and elsewhere in the Philippines over the US military presence in the country.
